what: Coverage of the 95% confidence band from ipd_two_stage_curve, five covariates 45/50/55/60/65, twelve studies, known quadratic truth. Measured with tools/coverage_ipd_curve.py. Two campaigns are recorded because the docstring quotes both: a 250-replication table of reference distributions, and a 60-replication head-to-head of covariance structures run later.

cr1_un.note: the shipped default, at the lower replication count used for the comparisons

cr2_un.note: measured and rejected: worse at every covariate and worst at the edge, because a study's marginal block already carries the between-study variance

cr1_hcs.note: measured and rejected: nothing at the edge, and the boundary rate rises from 73% to 98%

cr1_lkj2_un.note: the one change that helps: the boundary rate is halved and the edge rises to 0.750

cr1_lkj4_un.note: no further gain in coverage over eta = 2
